description:
Agrean Breakers, ver. 3.0

Download:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Bv67mRa3d0m5PBdCSktEmGCjKUMB2GrH?usp=sharing

Will run alongside "Everybody loves the Ko Combine" w/o conflicting or watering down those fleets, because the vessels

only

appear in the wild inside salvor fleets. So only Indies and Pirates get them. (Since Pirates also draw from the scavenger faction, salvor fleets are now a mixture of Indy, Pirate, and these-guys hulls). Now available in a variety of not-at-all-lurid Ko Combine colors!

Refitted for the Breakers:

Custom Hulls:

Warship Rehabilitation:

Lore (Watsonian):  Agreus is home to hundreds and hundreds of ship hulls, many of which are no longer economical to refurbish and sell to the Hegemony. But what about the other buyers in the Sector?  This mod assumes sub-contractors on Agreus refurbing to civilian state, setting it to run with as little crew as possible (read: add built-in Efficiency Overhaul), and selling it for a profit. The Ko Combine wants to get back to being in the big leagues, and its immediate play is maintaining solid relations with nearby Nova Maxios while putting out as many Independents-friendly hulls as possible on a custom basis. N.M. gets the "standard" hull business (somebody has to sell all those Shepherds to the Luddics, after all), whereas Agreus specializes in recycling and ship rebuilds, allowing it to get into wackier custom stuff. In my head-canon, Heggie suzerainty means that the K.C. are limited to putting out civilian hulls (even if some of them stretch the definitions to incredulity). The "Agrean" tech style denotes a civilian hull refurbed from the get-go for efficiency.

Lore (Doylist): Much the same, only I wanted lots of additional ships to be available w/o greatly altering the vanilla fleets one encounters regular, which can result in ship bloat. So the head-canon is that Ko Combine is cooperating with Nova Maxios, and it's putting out hulls primarily of use to salvors, while N.M. focuses on the surveyor and Indy-warship business. The Salvager faction has been altered to greatly emphasize the use of combat freighters, etc., over pure warships (every ship must carry its weight economically, or these fleets can't make a profit).  In ship_roles, these are "civilian miscellaneous" but might eventually get slotted into the "combat freighter" role pending any feedback. They can be obtained from arms dealers but not fleet markets for those who want go-fast civvy versions of their existing survey-and-salvage fleets. Game balance on these ships will differ from their vanilla counterparts. For example, the Colossus refits will be able to actually fire from all their turrets, making them much more effective in their roles than the intentionally-awful pirate refits from which they derive.

The shift in salvor fleets to emphasize more combat freighters over warships should make them more useful for Alex's incoming trade options as well (which is, honestly, why I'm posting it in the first place. I know I'm wayyyy out of step with most of the playerbase in terms of playstyle).

I've made limited but notable use of built-in weaponry for some ships, while still giving some leeway for customization. I think built-ins can be an important part of flavor and balancing. Almost every hangar is set up like Ventures and Shepherds, with built in drones -- they're dual-use technology which can defend you from pirates while also doing actual work for you. (Much as a ship sporting Terminator drones being misused as Very Large Missile Racks is overdue, that doesn't fit this vibe). This is set up to make salvors notably different in feel from mercs and raiders. Obtained from dealers, you could use these to haul cargo while setting up really irritating drone swarms to muck with incoming Talon Swarms.

*a thank you to UnitGTX48 for his quick-edit on the Cowboy

aiDescription: This mod introduces a variety of custom hulls and refitted vessels that appear in salvor fleets. The ships are designed to run with built-in Efficiency Overhaul and are primarily available to Indies and Pirates. The mod includes lore explaining the collaboration between the Ko Combine and Nova Maxios to produce these hulls for the salvor market.

changelog.3.0: Some minor fixes, numerous ships added.
